name: taisho_otome_bride
about: Taisho Otome story Short: Tamahiko grew up unloved and his father throws him out as useless; Yuzu arrives as the bride his father bought, and says she wants to love him - the drop opens their year together (Tokyo, the escalator, her tears, his blush, the bicycle under the stars), and he ends on wanting to make her happy.

story.why: Tamahiko: born to means, grew up without a drop of love
father: a good-for-nothing has no place here, get out of my sight
Yuzu: my name's Yuzuki, I'm here to be your bride
Yuzu: I want to be with you... and I want to love them

outro.why: Tamahiko: my heart was caught... I want to make Yuzu happy

title: Disowned By His Father, He Got A BRIDE He Never Asked For - Taisho Otome
hook: Thrown out by his own family, Tamahiko expected to die alone. Then Yuzu knocked on the door.
